note: The shared slur list (PRD §3.9.4, lint C23): a conservative seed of terms that are slurs in every common sense. Terms and allowlist entries are ROT13-encoded so they never show up in diffs, search results, logs or agent transcripts; tools decode them only in memory and never print them. To review, decode locally: node -e "const f=require('./content/reference/slurs.json');console.log(f.terms.map(t=>t.replace(/[a-z]/gi,c=>String.fromCharCode((c<='Z'?65:97)+((c.charCodeAt(0)-(c<='Z'?65:97)+13)%26)))).join('\n'))". Matching folds case and accents; terms of five letters or fewer match whole words only (with plural endings), longer ones also inside words, and allowlisted phrases are removed first. MOD-1 owns the player-facing filter in content/safety/ (ARCHITECTURE §8.13); when that list exists, the content lint reads both.
